::: {.section-intro}
Talks are classified by how they came about: *invited talks* are presentations given at the organisers' invitation; *conference presentations* are accepted contributed talks; *seminars* and *technical presentations* are research reports to groups and collaborations; *outreach & student seminars* are presentations to students and the public.
:::
